newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-JOHNSON STRIDES THROUGH FIRST ROUND.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-JOHNSON STRIDES THROUGH FIRST ROUND.

text.p: Double Olympic champion Michael Johnson strode through the first round of the men's 400 metres on the second day of the world championships on Sunday with no sign of the quadriceps injury which has disrupted his season.
Johnson clocked 45.66 seconds, glancing both to the right and left in the straight to check on the progress of his rivals before easing up at the line.
The 29-year-old American was given a wild card to compete here after missing the U.S. trials.
